spec.title: Add global settings panel with Yolo mode toggle
spec.context: The GUI currently has no way to enable "Yolo mode" (--dangerously-skip-permissions), which is essential for frictionless automation. Users who want skip-permissions behavior must configure it outside the GUI. Additionally, action buttons (change project, create task) are currently embedded in the TaskList panel header rather than a global header.

in-scope.item: Add global header bar to App.vue above the resizable panels
Move FolderOpen (change project) button from TaskList to global header
Move "New +" dropdown (Create Task, Discover) from TaskList to global header
Add settings icon button to global header (right side)
Create Popover component for settings panel
Add Switch toggle for Yolo mode with description and warning text
Persist Yolo mode setting via electron-store
Pass --dangerously-skip-permissions flag to Claude when Yolo mode enabled

requirements.requirement: The system shall display a global header bar above the resizable panels containing action buttons and settings
The system shall display a FolderOpen icon button in the header that opens the project picker dialog
The system shall display a "New +" dropdown in the header with Create Task and Discover options
The system shall display a settings icon button on the right side of the header
The system shall open a Popover when the settings icon is clicked
The system shall display a Switch toggle labeled "Yolo mode" in the settings popover
The system shall display a description explaining what Yolo mode does
The system shall display a red warning about potential danger when Yolo mode is discussed
The system shall persist the Yolo mode setting across GUI restarts using electron-store
The system shall pass --dangerously-skip-permissions flag to Claude CLI when Yolo mode is enabled
The system shall NOT pass the flag when Yolo mode is disabled
The TaskList panel header shall be simplified to only show the "Tasks" title

research.product: No existing product doc for gui/settings. This task establishes the settings panel feature.
research.engineering: Architecture follows Computer/Capability/Orchestrator pattern per directives. Vue components must be thin - logic in orchestrators. All shared state via createContext pattern.
research.codebase: Settings module exists at apps/gui/src/settings/ with full pattern implementation. TaskList.vue:54-84 contains buttons to relocate. App.vue currently has no header - goes directly to ResizablePanelGroup. pty-service.ts spawns Claude with pty.spawn('claude', [args]).
research.pitfalls: PTY flag must be separate arg, not embedded in command string. Store schema update required for new setting. env.d.ts must stay in sync with preload API changes. Terminal orchestrator needs settings access for yoloMode - requires DI update.

constraints.constraint: Must follow acyclic architecture - no capability importing capability
Vue components must be thin - inject orchestrator, call methods
All exports must have explicit return types
Popover must be installed via shadcn-vue CLI for consistency

dependencies.dependency: shadcn-vue popover component (install via npx shadcn-vue@latest add popover)
Settings orchestrator must be injected into terminal orchestrator

risk.mitigation: Pass as separate arg in spawn array

risks.risk: Flag injection could break if embedded in command string
Type mismatch between preload and env.d.ts if not synced
